description: A recorded simulated controller outage: detach, Stop B, A fails over to D alone, reattach, C replays what it held, the controller catches up and confirms the route. Events are the WebSocket messages in order, as sent. Apply outage-run.snapshot-initial.json first, then the events; or start from outage-run.snapshot-mid.json and discard events with event_id <= its last_event_id.

presenter_script.what: presenter detaches the gateway (the controller is away)
